ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters localized at distal tips of both lobes. Numerous linear high-contrast streaks distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes against a primary low-intensity dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels) and variable frequency; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the distal thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve sweeping upward from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, roughly circular white pixel clusters (approx. 3-6 pixels diameter) visible near the right lobe tip and upper medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying orientations; prominent parallel groupings are visible on the mid-left lobe and crossing the upper-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks covering approximately 20% of the visible surface area; minor irregular notches on the trailing edge profile.
